lead.headline: PUTIN VOWS 'INEVITABLE' REVENGE AS DRONES HIT TWO MORE REFINERIES OVERNIGHT
lead.summary: Putin told Kremlin officials on Tuesday that retaliation is 'inevitable' after Ukraine kept hitting refineries despite Trump's plea. Two Samara refineries were reported hit overnight; neither side confirmed it.

secondary.headline: SHENZHOU-24 LIFTS OFF WITH FIRST FOREIGN ASTRONAUT TO TIANGONG
secondary.summary: China launched Shenzhou-24 at 00:18 UTC from Jiuquan, carrying Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi and Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, 40 — the first foreign astronaut to visit the Tiangong station, and the first Pakistani in orbit.

secondary.headline: SAUDI COALITION HITS HODEIDAH PORT AFTER HOUTHIS THREATEN JEDDAH
secondary.summary: The Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port early on Wednesday after the Houthis threatened Jeddah and every Saudi Red Sea port. The coalition said it hit the port's operational capabilities; no casualties were reported.
